title: Three ways to learn
summary: Supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised, told apart by what is labeled.

choices.text: Predicting a sale price from past sales, each of which has a recorded price, is supervised regression.
Fitting a document classifier on a few thousand labeled articles plus a large pile of unlabeled ones is semi-supervised learning.
Semi-supervised learning means every label is present and some features are blank.
Grouping shoppers by their purchase vectors when nobody has assigned a segment label is unsupervised clustering.
